Author: IndividualGather
Name: XIV MCP
Punchline: Uplink AI assistants to Final Fantasy XIV through the Model Context Protocol.
Description:
XIV MCP runs a local MCP server (only reachable from your own PC, protected by an access token) so any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol can see your game and help with it.

Read your character live: stats and jobs, gear, inventory, currencies, quests, achievements and unlocks, party, targets, nearby objects, FATEs and the game's data sheets.

Retainers and submersibles are remembered between visits, each with its age and a hint on how to refresh it.

Optional features, each behind its own switch in /xivmcp:
- Game interaction: open game windows and use objects such as the summoning bell, company chest or voyage control panel.
- Inventory actions: sort with the game's own sorting, move items between bags, armory, saddlebag and retainers.
- Plugin management: enable, disable or reload plugins and edit their settings, with backups.
